title: Updating the coins register
statement: For a register state $\sigma$ and a natural number $y$, updating entry $10$ of its register vector to $y$ gives the register vector of the state obtained by replacing the number of coins remaining in $\sigma$ by $y$.
replaced:
For a register record and a natural number $y$, updating the entry at index $10$ of its
length-fifteen value vector to $y$ gives the value vector of the record obtained by
replacing the number of coins left with $y$.
